page.overview:
Who is Todd Snap?

Todd Snap is the main protagonist of Pokémon Snap and a supporting character in New Pokémon Snap.

In Pokémon Snap, Todd Snap is a boy with medium length thick brown hair and light skin. He wears a pink and purple striped shirt with brown shorts, boots, and fingerless gloves.

In New Pokémon Snap, Todd is now a grown man with a similar haircut to his younger self. He now wears a white vest with black shoulders, chest, and upper back with a raised collar over a solid red long sleeved shirt. He wears blue pants and black fingerless gloves.

Todd is shown to be friendly and encouraging towards fellow photographers.
